meta.name: ai-shaped-readiness-advisor
meta.description: Assess whether your product work is AI-first or AI-shaped. Use when evaluating AI maturity and choosing the next team capability to build.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估产品工作的AI成熟度并规划团队能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要判断产品是否具备AI就绪度并决定下一步建设方向。
copy.tagline_en: Assess AI maturity of your product work and plan team capabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate whether your product is AI-ready and decide what to build next.

howto.what: Claude 会通过一系列问题评估你的团队在5项AI能力上的成熟度，判断你是“AI优先”（用AI加速现有任务）还是“AI重塑”（围绕AI重新设计工作方式），并给出下一步优先提升哪项能力的建议。
howto.when: 当你描述团队当前如何使用AI（例如“我们用ChatGPT写PRD草稿和会议摘要”），或直接要求评估AI成熟度时触发。

say.text: 评估我的团队：6个PM，用ChatGPT写PRD和会议摘要，但流程没变。
say.note: Claude会收集背景并开始评估。

say.text: 我们团队用AI工具，但不确定是否真正改变了工作方式。
say.note: Claude会引导你完成成熟度评估。

howto.what_en: Claude assesses your team's maturity across 5 AI competencies, determines if you are AI-first (using AI to speed up existing tasks) or AI-shaped (redesigning work around AI), and recommends which capability to build next.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you describe how your team currently uses AI (e.g., 'We use ChatGPT for PRD drafts and meeting summaries') or ask for an AI maturity assessment.

say_en.text: Assess my team: 6 PMs, we use ChatGPT for PRD drafts and meeting summaries but nothing has changed.
say_en.note: Claude gathers context and starts assessment.

say_en.text: Our team uses AI tools but I'm not sure if we're working differently.
say_en.note: Claude guides you through the maturity assessment.
